name: state-in-url
description: state-in-url is an open-source React hook library that stores complex, typed, JSON-serializable state in URL query parameters, so filters, multi-step forms, and expanded panels survive a page reload and can be shared as a link. It is roughly 2 KB with no runtime dependencies, preserves the types and nested structure of the state object, and supports the Next.js App Router (14, 15, 16), React Router 6 and 7, Remix 2, and plain React. MIT licensed, maintained by Aleksandr Smyshliaev.
